title: Ordered coordinates of an algebraic localization cone
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f:Fin(r+1) to A, and S=A[1/f(0)]. Define M(0)=A and M(q+1)=the product, over increasing embeddings t:Fin(q+1) into Fin r, of A[1/product_i f((t i).succ)]. Let d_n:M(n) to M(n+1) be A-linear maps, and l_qtj the A-algebra maps from the localization at the face product to the localization at the full tail product. Assume d_0 is diagonal localization and d_(q+1) has the alternating face-sum formula with l_qtj. Then the modules M(q+1) times (S tensor_A M(q)) have A-linear equivalences E_q to the product indexed by increasing embeddings Fin(q+1) into Fin(r+1) of localization at the corresponding full f-product. There exist full-list face A-algebra maps l′ such that E_0(d_0 x,1 tensor x) is diagonal localization of x, and E_(q+1)(d_(q+1)u,1 tensor u-(id_S tensor d_q)v) is the alternating full-list face sum of E_q(u,v). This is purely a statement of module algebra, with no complexes, sheaves, augmentation, or tensor totalization.

proof.text: Use the explicit ringCechConeEquiv of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-cech-cone-linear-equiv] for every degree. It constructs the equivalences from the zero-containing subset partition, finite-product tensor distribution and localization at a product.

Choose ringCechFace as the full-list face maps. Each given tail face algebra map l equals the corresponding canonical map by localization uniqueness. By hd0 and hd the supplied differentials therefore equal ringCechDifferential, using extensionality and equality of each alternating-sum term.

After substituting the canonical differentials, use ringCechConeEquiv_d_zero for the augmented identity and ringCechConeEquiv_d for the later identity. Evaluate at each requested subset and expand ringCechDifferential_succ to obtain the original face sum.

theorem ringCechAlgebraicCone_coordinates (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (r : ℕ)
    (f : Fin (r + 1) → A)
    (d : ∀ n : ℕ, ringCechTailTerm A r (fun i ↦ f i.succ) n →ₗ[A]
      ringCechTailTerm A r (fun i ↦ f i.succ) (n + 1))
    (l : ∀ (q : ℕ) (t : Fin (q + 2) ↪o Fin r) (j : Fin (q + 2)),
      Localization.Away (∏ i, f (t (Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j i)).succ) →ₐ[A]
        Localization.Away (∏ i, f (t i).succ))
    (hd₀ : ∀ (x : A) (t : Fin 1 ↪o Fin r),
      d 0 x t = algebraMap A (Localization.Away (∏ i, f (t i).succ)) x)
    (hd : ∀ (q : ℕ) (x : ringCechTailTerm A r (fun i ↦ f i.succ) (q + 1))
      (t : Fin (q + 2) ↪o Fin r),
      d (q + 1) x t = ∑ j : Fin (q + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val •
        l q t j (x ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j).trans t))) :
    let M := ringCechTailTerm A r (fun i ↦ f i.succ)
    let S := Localization.Away (f 0)
    ∃ (E : ∀ q : ℕ, (M (q + 1) × (S ⊗[A] M q)) ≃ₗ[A]
        ((t : Fin (q + 1) ↪o Fin (r + 1)) → Localization.Away (∏ i, f (t i))))
      (l' : ∀ (q : ℕ) (t : Fin (q + 2) ↪o Fin (r + 1)) (j : Fin (q + 2)),
        Localization.Away (∏ i, f (t (Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j i))) →ₐ[A]
          Localization.Away (∏ i, f (t i))),
      (∀ (x : A) (t : Fin 1 ↪o Fin (r + 1)),
        E 0 (d 0 x, 1 ⊗ₜ[A] x) t =
          algebraMap A (Localization.Away (∏ i, f (t i))) x) ∧
      (∀ (q : ℕ) (x : M (q + 1)) (y : S ⊗[A] M q)
        (t : Fin (q + 2) ↪o Fin (r + 1)),
        E (q + 1) (d (q + 1) x,
          1 ⊗ₜ[A] x - TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : S →ₗ[A] S) (d q) y) t =
          ∑ j : Fin (q + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val •
            l' q t j (E q (x, y) ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j).trans t)))
